answer: The first African American mayor of the most populous city in the United States, which is New York City, was **David Dinkins**. He was elected to the office in 1989 and began his term in 1990, serving until 1993. His election marked a historic moment, as he became the first Black person to lead New York City, which has a population of over 8 million people.
